selectionRationale.objective: Among hydraulically accepted geometries with a contiguous window of at least 20.0 rpm, select the second-smallest distinct adequate diameter as a one-grid-step pre-pilot design margin. No fallback to the smallest diameter.
ordering: useful-window preference: widthRpm >= minimumUsefulWindowRpm (ranking preference only; not a hydraulic limit)
sort distinct accepted adequate diameters ascending; retain the first as SMALLEST_ACCEPTED_ADEQUATE_DIAMETER and select the second as SELECTED_NEXT_SMALLEST_ACCEPTED_DIAMETER
for equal diameter: window width descending
edgeMarginRpm, validTrialCount, representative RPM distance, P/V, hc/D, rotor/D, and free area as deterministic tie-breaks
retain Pareto frontier by minimizing diameter and maximizing contiguous window width; report wider frontier alternatives rather than converting tradeoffs into a fabricated score

dispersed.conversion: (RRBO m3/s * RRBO kg/m3 * S/O) / wet-solvent kg/m3

assumptions: Np=1.2 fixed engineering assumption; distinct from Garthe source power number
C32=.36,.42,.43 conditional Sauter-mean proxy, not Hinze maximum stable diameter
Spherical drop and turbulent breakup assumptions remain unqualified; diagnostics are not acceptance thresholds
BP and SN interface scenarios are mandatory, neither is established as actual
Lower quasi-steady branch is not proof of dynamical stability; capacity is not observed flood
